uncertainty: Eight independent phase-one pools; delta-method paired SE from between-pool raw moment covariance, Student-t(df=7) intervals, plus separate conditional SRSWOR design SE and delete-one-pool diagnostics. Conditional design variance is not added again to between-pool variance.
stopping_rule: All eight pools and registered stratum samples are completed regardless of energy signs. Within each nonempty stratum use SRSWOR with known n/N probability; census the extreme stratum. Fail closed on resource cap, source change, or amplitude mismatch. No threshold/step/operator/proposal tuning, no old samples in new estimates.
scope: Fixed strict-SU2/A1 finite-state audit only. Full cheap carrier moments plus inverse-inclusion weighted quadratic correction moments. Estimated ratios can have finite-sample bias; finite phase-one pools cannot guarantee unobserved-tail or equilibration coverage.
